title: 2D Ehrhart Polynomial via Pick's Theorem
description: Formalize the Ehrhart polynomial L(P,t) = A·t² + (B/2)·t + 1 for 2D convex lattice polygons. Proved via three independent routes: (1) Finset.card_product for rectangles, (2) Nat.antidiagonal biUnion + Gauss sum for right triangles, (3) algebraically from Pick's theorem and scaling axioms. Includes Ehrhart-Macdonald reciprocity and h*-vector non-negativity.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: Proved L(P,t) = A·t² + (B/2)·t + 1 via three routes. 0 sorries, 3 axioms (picks_theorem, scaled_area, scaled_boundary). Rectangle and triangle cases proved with 0 axioms.
insights: The antidiagonal biUnion decomposition gives the cleanest triangle Ehrhart proof: row k of Δ_n has k+1 lattice points = antidiag(k).card
